text:
alex: Quick sync — Q2 hosted API prioritization. We need a clear mapping from customer buckets -> launch criteria. Major asks: low-latency chat for SaaS PLG customers, 99.9% embedding availability for a vector DB partner, and deterministic rerank accuracy for an enterprise search customer. Who wants to start with acceptance criteria?
mira: For chat latency: target p95 < 300ms for small responses (<128 tokens) on our hosted tier. Also: streaming for partial responses by GA.
samir: Embeddings SLA: partner expects 99.9% availability and per-request latency p95 < 150ms if they batch. Key constraint is cold-cache warmup for prefix caching.
ellie: Rerank: customer cares about stability of top-5. We should define a baseline eval set + allowable delta (no more than 1.5% MRR drop vs current). Also need explainability logs for audits.
sasha: Ops asks: each of these needs a canary plan + automatic fallback to smaller model. Can we commit to region fallback + metric thresholds?
alex: Proposed gating checklist (draft):
- perf SLOs (latency / availability) met on staging load tests
- quality check (eval harness on fixed prompt set)
- rollout plan (canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%)
- rollback triggers + cost guardrails
- billing/quotas enabled
Can we make that the standard?
mira: yes but add: quantization profile validated (if used) for quality regression < 1% on eval set.
samir: also add batch sizing guidance and default knob values. Many customers will rely on it to meet latency/throughput tradeoffs.
ops_lead: noted. Need instrumentation: per-route token counts, model-variant tag, cache-hit metrics, and a single dashboard. Without that we can't safely autoscale during canary.
alex: Owner proposals: chat -> mira, embeddings SLA -> samir, rerank -> ellie. Ops support -> sasha. Agree?
sasha: agreed. I'll draft canary playbook. Quick question: for embeddings SLA, do we promise customer-level dedicated capacity or soft SLO?
samir: they asked for 99.9% with data isolation. That implies dedicated or reserved pools. We should budget committed capacity for GA.
ellie: For rerank, we may avoid dedicated capacity if we can keep p99 low via KV cache and small-model rerank fallback. Save costs.
alex: Decision checkpoint: by Fri we want: spec with acceptance criteria, rough Q2 milestones, risk register. I'll schedule a 30m sync Thurs 10:30.
deploy-bot: Reminder: staging load tests scheduled Wed 09:00 - 12:00 (env: q2-prio).
mira: I'll have perf numbers from a 10-node staging run by Wed EOD.
samir: I'll list partner contract ask and estimated reserved GPU hours by Wed.
sasha: I'll produce canary checklist + failure modes doc by Thu morning.
alex: Perfect. If anyone needs to reassign owners, ping me. Thanks :thumbsup:
ellie: quick note — include rerank A/B metric hooks for MRR and latency in the eval plan.
alex: will do. End of thread.
